title: a misty morning in the wilderness - enjoying a gentle autumn
en: it is far too early for winter but i did see a sprinkling of snow up in the mountains today and realize no doubt it'll reach me before the autumn is over i would love a few more months to enjoy the golden fields covered in leaves but i still need to prepare for the ice and snow i got to visit my sister last week and so i only had time to film little snippets from my days at the cottage but i thought i'd still share a little of what i've been up to

so while my flowers are all but gone due to more frost i did manage to save some containers by bringing them indoors i will no doubt keep these around long after they have wilted and left pollen everywhere because i always forget until they're completely dead i recently received a letter from a lovely viewer who said they just started

a creative career and were wondering what inspired me to pursue mine especially in regards to my art business and creating videos this is something i've been reflecting on recently because now that i've been doing it for a while i've been able to learn a lot and make many mistakes along the way i mentioned this in a past video but i thought i'd reiterate that i believe the most important thing you can do whenever you start out on a new life or career path is to know what you believe in regards to your own values and the vision behind what you're doing for example i always wanted to be able to create the art i love and share it with people whether or not that meant i could rely on it for a living which thankfully is now my main job if you have watched my art related videos and seen my work you know that my

art style is a niche to say the least it takes a lot of inspiration from fairy tales and children's illustration it doesn't appeal to a mass audience and i never intended it to because i knew that if i completely changed my art style or what i created just to be more successful that my passion for it would disappear i would rather do any other type of job then deny what i love to create that is also why i don't do sponsorships as you may have noticed because before i started my channel i decided it didn't align with what i was personally trying to communicate and that of course is not a reflection on other creators who do because i completely support them and am so happy it lets them keep creating

it just didn't fit into the philosophy of my personal channel and consequently i felt more free to occasionally highlight small businesses just starting out that can't afford to do sponsorships i want to pay these artists since i was in their position not too long ago and it feels like a meaningful way to give back i think that when we achieve a goal or the success we had in our mind's eye you're often left with the question of what now because there will always be someone out there that seems to be more successful or better at something than you it is so easy to compare with someone ahead of you and find yourself short

instead of looking back and being amazed at so proud of how far you've come that's something that means a lot to me and as my channel has grown i've held on so tightly to the philosophy i had when i first started of course we should always be flexible and open to expand our beliefs as long as we don't lose sight of what's truly important to us and what we set out to do in the first place for example there are so many things i could change about my videos and content that would no doubt attract a broader audience than i have now but then i would be wandering off the path of what i initially wanted to do in my case it was to afford living while also connecting with kindred spirits inspiring others to go outdoors and
preserve wild lands enjoy the magic of simply living day to day everything else is simply a bonus so
in short follow your heart always

because when your inner self and outer actions are in alignment i believe that is when you can meet your full potential and find lasting joy in the process i hope you have a lovely day or night and i'm sending you my love
zh: 对于冬天来说还为时过早，但今天我确实看到山上飘着雪花，并且意识到毫无疑问它会在秋天结束之前到达我身边，我希望再有几个月的时间来欣赏树叶覆盖的金色田野，但我仍然需要为冰雪做好准备。
因此，虽然我的花由于更多的霜冻而几乎消失了，但我确实设法通过将它们带入室内来保存一些容器，毫无疑问，在它们枯萎并留下花粉到处都是之后，我无疑会将它们保留很长时间，因为我总是忘记，直到它们完全死了我最近收到了一封来自一位可爱的观众的来信，他说它们刚刚开始

我想知道是什么激励我追求我的事业，特别是在我的艺术事业和制作视频方面，这是我最近一直在反思的事情，因为现在我已经做了一段时间了，我已经学到了很多东西，也犯了很多错误，我在过去的视频中提到过这一点，但我想我会重申，我相信，每当你开始新的生活或职业道路时，你可以做的最重要的事情就是知道你对自己的价值观和你背后的愿景的信念例如，我一直希望能够创造我喜欢的艺术并与人们分享，无论这是否意味着我可以依靠它谋生，谢天谢地，这现在是我的主要工作，如果你看过我的艺术相关视频并看过我的作品，你知道我的

至少可以说，艺术风格是一个小众领域，它需要从童话故事和儿童插画中获得很多灵感，它不会吸引大众，而且我从来没有想过这样做，因为我知道，如果我完全改变我的艺术风格或我创造的东西只是为了更成功，我对它的热情就会消失，我宁愿做任何其他类型的工作，然后否认我喜欢创造的东西，这也是我不做赞助的原因，你可能已经注意到，因为在我开始我的频道之前，我认为它与我的想法不符。个人尝试沟通，这当然不是对其他创作者的反映，因为我完全支持他们，并且很高兴这让他们继续创作
它只是不符合我个人频道的理念，因此我觉得偶尔会更自由地强调刚起步的小企业，无力承担赞助费用，因为不久前我就处于他们的位置，所以我想向这些艺术家支付费用，这感觉像是一种有意义的回馈方式，我认为当我们实现目标或我们心目中的成功时，你经常会留下一个问题：现在做什么，因为总会有人似乎比你更成功或更擅长某件事，这很容易与排在你前面的人比较并发现自己不够

不要回首过去，为自己所取得的成就感到惊讶，这对我来说意义重大，随着我的频道的发展，我紧紧抓住了我刚开始时的理念，当然，只要我们不忽视对我们真正重要的事情以及我们一开始要做的事情，我们就应该始终保持灵活和开放的态度来扩展我们的信念，例如，我可以对我的视频和内容进行很多改变，这无疑会吸引更广泛的观众我现在已经做到了，但那时我就会偏离我最初想做的事情的道路，就我而言，那就是负担得起生活，同时也与志同道合的人联系，鼓励其他人去户外，
保护野生土地 享受简单生活的魔力 其他一切都只是额外的好处 所以
简而言之，永远跟随你的心
因为当你的内在自我和外在行为保持一致时，我相信你就能充分发挥自己的潜力，并在这个过程中找到持久的快乐，我希望你度过一个美好的白天或夜晚，我向你致以我的爱
